description: This file declares the NetworkManagerClient class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. It provides an interface for managing network interfaces, Wi-Fi operations, IP settings, and related functionalities via D-Bus in a Linux environment. The class includes methods for retrieving interface information, configuring interfaces, managing Wi-Fi connections, handling WPS, and other network management tasks.

classes.name: NetworkManagerClient
classes.description: Singleton class providing network management functionalities such as interface configurations, Wi-Fi operations, WPS handling, and IP settings management via D-Bus.

methods.name: NetworkManagerClient * getInstance()
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of NetworkManagerClient.

methods.name: getAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves a list of available network interfaces.

methods.name: setPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Sets the specified interface as the primary network interface.

methods.name: setInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: setIPSettings
methods.description: Configures IP settings for a given interface.

methods.name: getPrimaryInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the primary network interface.

methods.name: getDefaultInterface
methods.description: Retrieves the default network interface.

methods.name: getInterfaceState
methods.description: Checks if a specified interface is enabled.

methods.name: getIPSettings
methods.description: Retrieves IP settings for a specified interface and IP version.

methods.name: getKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Gets the list of known Wi-Fi SSIDs.

methods.name: getConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves information about the currently connected Wi-Fi SSID.

methods.name: addToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a Wi-Fi network to the known SSIDs list.

methods.name: removeKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Removes a Wi-Fi network from the known SSIDs list.

methods.name: startWifiScan
methods.description: Initiates Wi-Fi scanning, optionally for a specific SSID.

methods.name: isWifiScannedRecently
methods.description: Checks if Wi-Fi scan was performed recently within a given time limit.

methods.name: getDeviceInfo
methods.description: Retrieves device information for a specific interface.

methods.name: wifiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a Wi-Fi network with specified credentials.

methods.name: wifiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from the current Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: activateKnownConnection
methods.description: Activates a previously known Wi-Fi connection.

methods.name: getWifiState
methods.description: Retrieves the current Wi-Fi state.

methods.name: getWiFiSignalQuality
methods.description: Gets the signal quality of a Wi-Fi network.

methods.name: startWPS
methods.description: Starts a WPS (Wi-Fi Protected Setup) process.

methods.name: stopWPS
methods.description: Stops the ongoing WPS process.

methods.name: setHostname
methods.description: Sets the device hostname.

methods.name: modifyDefaultConnectionsConfig
methods.description: Modifies default connection configurations.
